meta.parties: Sangarapillai v. Devaraja Mudaliyar Et Al

rules.statement: A husband retains full power to mortgage common property, including tediatetam property, during the subsistence of marriage under the Jaffna Matrimonial Rights and Inheritance Ordinance No. 1 of 1911.
rules.supporting_quote: "I can find nothing in the Ordinance inconsistent with an intention to retain in force the rights of the husband over the common property."
